tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels, on the board and the website.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Header, timeline, cards and docs surfaces.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sheets and dialogs that float over the board.

tokens.name: panel-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset areas inside a raised panel: the touch panel's card column, fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and panel outlines.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, selects, inputs and chips on panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on bg, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Running text on the website and secondary text that must stay easy to read.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, event numbers, summaries. Never for anything a person must act on.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main buttons, the selected segment, Play in the timeline, links. Navy in light, cyan in dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered or keyboard-focused menu rows.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The current page in the docs sidebar and step numbers on the website.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: The timeline step the board is showing; the current turn in the turn list.

tokens.name: note-bg
tokens.usage: Coaching notes under timeline lines; prompt bubbles on the website.

tokens.name: note-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a note box.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Text in a note box or prompt bubble.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warnings chip, the Refresh needed and Connected before callouts.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a warning.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon in a warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Knock Out and other destructive actions, as text.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive button on touch.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a destructive button on touch.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The connection dot when connected. Always beside the word Live.

tokens.name: seat-p1
tokens.usage: Player 1 dots and timeline headings on panels. A dot or rule, never body text.

tokens.name: seat-p2
tokens.usage: Player 2 dots and timeline headings on panels. A dot or rule, never body text (3.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: scrub-p1
tokens.usage: Player 1 stretches of the timeline scrubber.

tokens.name: scrub-p2
tokens.usage: Player 2 stretches of the timeline scrubber.

tokens.name: scrub-setup
tokens.usage: The setup stretch at the start of the timeline scrubber.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: The mark's cards and arrow; icons on dark grounds. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: turn-tag-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-navy turn tags and step numbers (T5).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: End turn, and only End turn. Same in every theme so it is always findable.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: seat-p1-mat

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The home page headline only. Scales down to 32px on a phone.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The h1 of a docs page.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles of feature and guide cards.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text on the website. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Names in the Active readout, menu headers, the turn strip.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Timeline lines, menu items, buttons on the board.

styles.name: ui-s
styles.usage: Labels on the mat, pile chips, small buttons.

styles.usage: Menu section labels and sidebar headings, set in capitals.

styles.name: hp-xl
styles.usage: HP left in the Active readout (32px on the narrow layout).

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Step counter, damage values, counts in chips, branch names.

styles.name: num-s
styles.usage: Event numbers in the timeline, HP under Bench cards.

tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; padding inside small chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the website's side gutter on a phone.

tokens.usage: Card padding on the website.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.usage: Space between website sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-12
